blocks.text: SINGAPORE — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will attend the Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix during his working visit here, Malacañang confirmed on Friday, citing opportunities to meet business leaders and discuss potential investments. Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said Marcos was invited by Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong and viewed the event as an opportunity for face-to-face engagement. “Dadaló po siya (He will attend),” Castro said at a press briefing when asked whether the president would attend. “Sa ganoong mga klase ng mga imbitasyon, hindi lang sila manonood.
